_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
O wena Mmoki {player_id}, o dulang {num_rounds} dithulaganyo tsa Iterated Ultimatum Game.
O na le ${pool} go akaretsa mo lefelong leno la round kwa wena le Mmoki {other_id}.

Mmopi:
  - Dirisa seabe: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ika seabe se a amogelwa → Wena o iponelela $(pool - X), mmoki wa gape o iponelela $X
  - Ika seabe se ka se amogelwe → Ba babedi ba iponelela $0
  - Senao: [Offer: $3]  kgotsa  'Ke ikutlwa ke go siame. [Offer: $5]'

Karabo wa Mmoki:
  - Tshwanetse go dira seabe ka [Accept] kgotsa [Reject]
  - Senao: 'Go bonala go siame. [Accept]'
            'Go feta bokgopo. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Round {round_number} e simolola! ---
Mmoki {proposer_id} ke mmopi, Mmoki {responder_id} ke mmoki wa karabo.
round.offer: Round {round_number}: Mmoki {proposer_id} o dirisa ${offer} ho Mmoki {responder_id} (a tsamaya le ${keep}).
round.accepted: Mmoki {responder_id} o amogele! Round {round_number} o iponetse: Mmoki {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Mmoki {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Diponetse tsa gale: Mmoki 0: ${total_0}, Mmoki 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Mmoki {responder_id} o tlogetse seabe! Round {round_number} o iponetse: Ba babedi ba iponetse +$0. Diponetse di tsile: Mmoki 0: ${total_0}, Mmoki 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Motlhami o tshwanetse go dira kopo a dirisa fomete ya [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Madi a o a neelwang e tshwanetse go nna palo ya nnete.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Thekiso e tshwanetse go nna magareng ga $0 le ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: No current offer to respond to.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Mojaki wa karabo o swanetse go [Accept] kgotsa [Reject] seabe.

outcome.win: Mmoki {winner} o ile a fenya le ${winner_total} yotlhe kgatlhanong le Mmoki {loser} ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Go ne ga nna le go sa tshwane! Badiri ka bobedi ba feletse ka ${total} palogotlhe.
